title: Config
description: Repo wiring: environments, change classes, fact providers (ADR-0010 config.yaml), and the optional profile precedence table (P3-E4-S02). Safety-bearing: unknown fields/enum values reject at every level (ADR-0017 §9).

environments.description: Environment classifier; last match wins as the documented default (ADR-0010).

classes.description: Change-class classifier; MergePolicy packs are routed to classes via RulesetBinding.

profiles.description: Ordered profile precedence table (schema-level artifact). Declares which PolicyProfile resources are active and their equal-specificity tie-break order. Not a second match/routing block — ADR-0008 RulesetBinding still routes packs; this only selects profile × (environment, class) interaction. Resolution algorithm + worked examples: docs/planning/policy-lifecycle-profiles.md. When present, assent lint enforces single-writer-profile across the referenced profiles.

providers.description: Keyed by provider name (surfaced to rules as facts.<name>.*, ADR-0004).

presentation.description: Tier-0 renderer knobs (ADR-0016 §1, D-088): verbosity, emoji, collapse threshold, locale, and optional per-environment overrides.

paths.description: Glob patterns against repo-relative file paths.

type.description: Provider implementation identifier (e.g. builtin/gitlab-groups, http, exec).

failure.description: closed (default) demotes an unresolved fact to fail-safe (ADR-0004); a controlling/authorization provider may never be configured open (lint hard error, docs/planning/lint-hard-errors.md).

verbosity.description: How much evaluation detail to show in rendered forge comments (ADR-0016 §1).

collapseThreshold.description: Hide detail bodies beyond N same-code findings (D-089).

locale.description: Locale catalog id for fixed renderer chrome strings (ADR-0016 §5).

environments.description: Optional per-environment presentation overrides keyed by Config environment name (D-089).

name.description: Config environment name this override applies to.

verbosity.description: Override global verbosity for this environment.

emoji.description: Override global emoji setting for this environment.

collapseThreshold.description: Override global collapse threshold for this environment.

locale.description: Override global locale for this environment.
